Done — I created the single-file HTML app and shared it for download. The implementation includes the requested mobile web app meta tags for translucent status-bar behavior and uses highlight.js for code highlighting, both of which are consistent with the references I checked.[1][2]

The file is production-oriented and self-contained, with CSS, vanilla JavaScript, chat history UI, attachments, context menu, action sheet, SSE-style response scaffolding, and a WebGL2 rendering layer that tracks DOM elements and feeds their bounds into shader uniforms.[2][1]
